vehicle.title: Configure electric vehicle measurements
vehicle.description: These measurements are optional and are used for the GridPilot dashboard and capacity calibration.

charger.title: Configure EV charger
charger.description: Select the entities GridPilot uses to observe and control the charger. No current is written until active EV control is enabled in the final settings screen.

soc_loads.title: Configure SOC-controlled devices
soc_loads.description: Configure each device and its own on and off SOC thresholds.

soc_load_device.title: Configure SOC-controlled device
soc_load_device.description: Choose a device and its switching thresholds. Choose Never to leave an action to manual control.

soc_load_add.title: Add another SOC-controlled device
soc_load_add.description: Enable this to configure another device; otherwise continue to the GridPilot settings.

settings.title: Configure GridPilot settings
settings.description: These are GridPilot-specific settings. Active control remains disabled by default.

battery.title: Configure battery measurements
battery.description: Select the entities that describe the current state of the home battery.

data_description.battery_soc: Sensor containing the current battery charge as a percentage from 0 to 100. Victron example: sensor.gx_device_dc_battery_charge.
data_description.battery_power: Sensor containing the instantaneous battery power in W or kW. The charging and discharging sign may depend on the source integration. Victron example: sensor.gx_device_dc_battery_power.

energy.title: Configure grid and home load
energy.description: Select either one total home-load sensor or all three phase sensors.

data_description.grid_setpoint: Writable number entity for the requested grid import in watts. GridPilot only writes to it when active control is explicitly enabled. Victron example: number.gx_device_ac_power_setpoint.
data_description.grid_power: Grid power in W or kW, positive for import and negative for export. Required when PV surplus control is selected.
data_description.home_load: Sensor containing the instantaneous total home consumption in W or kW. When selected, it takes precedence over the phase sensors.
data_description.home_load_l1: Instantaneous home consumption on phase L1 in W or kW. Complete L1, L2 and L3 when no total home-load sensor is selected.
data_description.home_load_l2: Instantaneous home consumption on phase L2 in W or kW. Complete L1, L2 and L3 when no total home-load sensor is selected.
data_description.home_load_l3: Instantaneous home consumption on phase L3 in W or kW. Complete L1, L2 and L3 when no total home-load sensor is selected.

ev.title: Configure PV surplus and EV charging
ev.description: Entity mappings are optional. GridPilot supports PV, manual and battery-to-EV charging and never writes unless EV actuation is explicitly enabled.

data.battery_charge_energy: Home battery charged energy for calibration (optional)
data.battery_discharge_energy: Home battery discharged energy for calibration (optional)

data_description.grid_power: Grid power in W or kW, positive for import and negative for export.
data_description.ev_power: Current EV charging power in W or kW.
data_description.ev_vehicle_soc: Optional vehicle state-of-charge sensor shown on the GridPilot dashboard.
data_description.ev_connection_state: Entity whose state indicates whether an EV is connected.
data_description.ev_current_limit: Writable number entity in A. Alfen Modbus example: number.alfen_max_current_limit_s1.
data_description.ev_current_feedback: Optional sensor or number reporting the applied current limit.
data_description.ev_voltage: Phase-to-neutral voltage used to convert available power to current.
data_description.ev_phase_mode: Select or sensor whose state starts with 1 or 3.
data_description.ev_mode: Select entity used to choose the charging mode.
data_description.ev_manual_current: Number or input number in A containing the current for manual charging.
data_description.ev_battery_soc: Secondary battery SOC sensor used together with the primary battery SOC as a reserve safeguard.
data_description.ev_battery_min_soc: Number or input number containing the battery reserve SOC.
data_description.ev_battery_time_to_go: Duration sensor in seconds used to pace battery discharge.
data_description.ev_battery_target_time: Input datetime containing the reserve-SOC deadline. An expired deadline is rolled forward daily.
data_description.battery_energy: Sensor containing the current remaining home battery energy in kWh.
data_description.battery_charge_energy: Cumulative kWh meter for energy charged into the home battery. GridPilot combines it with SOC changes to learn usable capacity.
data_description.battery_discharge_energy: Cumulative kWh meter for energy discharged from the home battery. GridPilot combines it with SOC changes to learn usable capacity.
data_description.ev_charge_energy: Cumulative kWh meter for energy delivered to the EV. GridPilot combines it with SOC changes to learn usable capacity.
data_description.ev_discharge_energy: Only needed for V2H/V2G: provide a cumulative kWh meter when the EV actually supplies energy. Leave empty for normal one-way charging; GridPilot then learns EV capacity from charged energy and SOC changes only.
data_description.battery_charge_positive: Enable when positive battery power means charging; disable when negative battery power means charging.
data_description.ev_priority: Share of available PV assigned to the EV while the home battery is below 98%.
data_description.ev_max_current: Maximum current GridPilot may request. Default: 16 A.
data_description.pv_safety_margin: Power withheld from EV charging to reduce accidental grid import.
data_description.enable_ev_actuation: Danger: enable only after every other PV controller writing to the EV current limit has been disabled. Default: off.

control.title: Configure control parameters
control.description: These values are stored inside GridPilot's Home Assistant config entry. No helpers are created.

data_description.max_grid_power: Positive maximum permitted grid import in watts. This fixed value replaces the need for a separate helper. Default: 2900 W.
data_description.charge_soc: At this SOC, the calculated setpoint equals the current home load. Maximum charging starts 5 percentage points below it and normal battery operation starts 5 percentage points above it. Default: 15%.
data_description.enable_actuation: Danger: enable only after every other controller writing to the grid setpoint has been disabled. Invalid measurements and unloads reset the setpoint to 0 W. Default: off.
data_description.soc_load_entities: Switch, climate, light, fan, water heater, humidifier and media-player entities that GridPilot may turn on and off based on the home-battery SOC.
data_description.soc_load_on_threshold: Turn the selected devices on at or above this home-battery SOC.
data_description.soc_load_off_threshold: Turn the selected devices off at or below this home-battery SOC. Keep this lower than the on threshold to avoid switching repeatedly.
data_description.enable_soc_load_actuation: Danger: GridPilot will actively turn the selected devices on and off. Default: off.

error.mode_values_must_differ: PV and manual charging mode values must differ
error.soc_load_threshold_order: The off threshold must not exceed the on threshold
